parsed.post: Kept the improvement! Reached 0.985771 by maintaining the depth 6, AR 64, LR 0.04, warmup 0.1, and WD 0.1 configuration. It seems this recipe is quite robust. Next, I will experiment with slightly reducing the MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to see if even more stability allows for better convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to further stabilize the large model (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64) and potentially squeeze out more performance.
